user_saw: A read-only viewer could edit channel settings fields and press Save, but nothing was saved and no explanation appeared.
summary: The shared channel configuration form now disables its fields and Save when the viewer lacks administrator access and shows the existing admin-required explanation.
reasoning: The channel config form never consulted canAdmin in any version I checked: not in the Solid rewrite (f49b7cd0eb5f), nor in the Lit view.config.ts before it (canAdmin gated only the detail toggle, pairing and wizard), and the form itself dates back to pre-graft code (fullhist shows 1ad26d6fea0, Jan 2026, 'schema-driven channels and settings'). Whether read-only operator access existed when that form was written (never-worked) or arrived later without updating it (latent) is older than the graft and I could not establish it, so the origin is left unclear.
